ةﻮﻄﺨﺑ ةﻮﻄﺧ ..ﻚﺘﯾاﺮﻗ ﻲﻓPARAGRAPHS · UNIT 1 Travelling
I do believe that travelling is an excellent form of education and that it teaches you
more than most school books do. Now, whether it is actually the best form of
education probably depends on the people who travel. Some are simply interested in
getting glimpses of the sights which are praised unanimously, while others want to
have a real contact with the worlds that are different from their own.
If you belong to the latter category, you will draw more benefits from what you see
while you travel.
If everyone travelled at least once in his lifetime, there is no doubt the world would be a
better place. Travelling increases our knowledge and widens our perspective. It
provides tremendous opportunities for fun, adventure and discovery. When we visit
places in other countries, we gain a better understanding of the people living there.
We know about their culture, history and backgrounds. Travelling the world will open
our eyes and get rid of misconceptions we may have about other countries, people and
their lifestyles. It's a wonderful reality that the world is full of people who are at the
same time so different and so much like us. It's a great way to appreciate things about
your own hometown as well as to look at other things more reasonably. It's a good way
to realize that there really isn't one best place or country in the world but that we are all
one big family of humans making the best life we can wherever we live.
All things considered, if you travel a lot, you'll become more tolerant since you'll
understand and acquire other cultures much better.
C H A P I T R E 1
Travelling
First of all, you'll get a chance to see how other people lead their everyday life, and
this experience may eventually make you ask questions about your own standards.
–
Second, it's probably more enriching to see different civilisations by yourself than to
get through other people or through the media; this is because travelling to different
countries helps you to enrich your life.
–
